entries.canonical_text: If you're going to learn English words, start with the ones people use a lot. That's obviously right. There's no arguing with it. And yet, the moment a gacha appears in front of you, the good student inside you steps away. That may be true, but what's the rarest one? Wait. You came here to study today, didn't you? The Dopa English Word Gacha is just the thing to send your mind off track. English word cards have 7 rarity levels. The more often a word is used, the lower its level. the less often it is used, the higher. The words you'd want to learn first for study end up on the dull side in the gacha. Practical value and star power, surprisingly, live apart. Normally, you might think, Could I use this in conversation? But now you might lean forward and think, What? This word is hardly ever used! You check the rarity before reading the meaning. You thought you were opening a vocabulary book, but in your mind, a send-off for the rare-word hunters is already underway.

entries.canonical_text: An English-word gacha makes rare, less-used words the prize, even though common words are usually better to learn first. Rarity reflects word frequency, not what learners should study first. The game alone cannot show whether players will focus more on opening packs than memorizing words.
